# Unit Tests of the Benchmarking System {#sec-appendix-unit-tests}

| Test ID | What Is Checked | Input | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:------|:--------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|:--------|:-----|
| UT-01 | Each day gives posts in proportion to its matching posts | Sample of 50 posts. Days 1 to 3 have 600, 300, and 100 matching posts | 30, 15, and 5 posts |  |  |
| UT-02 | A day with too few eligible posts passes the rest of its share to the other days | Same as UT-01, but Day 3 has only 2 eligible posts | Day 3 gives 2 posts. The total stays 50. Day 1 receives more of the remaining 3 posts than Day 2 |  |  |
| UT-03 | A Taglish post is included | "Baha na sa amin, please send help" | Included |  |  |
| UT-04 | A post in one language is excluded | "Baha na naman sa amin" and "Stay safe everyone" | Both excluded |  |  |
| UT-05 | Reposts and quotes are excluded | A repost and a quote of an included post | Both excluded |  |  |
| UT-06 | Posts that differ only in a link are duplicates | "Baha na sa Marikina, ingat everyone" posted with two different links | One post kept |  |  |
| UT-07 | Near duplicates above 0.75 are removed | "baha sa marikina" and "baha sa marikina ngayon" | Similarity = 0.85. One post kept |  |  |
| UT-08 | Similar posts below 0.75 are kept | "baha sa marikina" and "baha sa cainta kahapon" | Similarity = 0.51. Both posts kept |  |  |
| UT-09 | Personal details are replaced with placeholders | A post with a username, a phone number, an email address, a link, and the name of a person | The first four replaced. The name kept |  |  |
| UT-10 | The split is stratified and stays the same | 100 posts, 50 each in categories A and B | Training = 36 A and 36 B. Validation = 7 A and 7 B. Test = 7 A and 7 B. No post in two sets. Same split on every run |  |  |
| UT-11 | The subsets of the learning curve are stratified and nested | 200 training posts, 100 each in categories A and B | 25% = 25 A and 25 B. 50% = 50 A and 50 B. 75% = 75 A and 75 B. Each subset lies inside the next larger one |  |  |

: Tests of Data Preparation {#tbl-unit-tests-data tbl-colwidths="[8,24,28,23,9,8]"}

| Test ID | What Is Checked | Input | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:------|:--------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|:--------|:-----|
| UT-12 | NER labels go on the first token of each word | "Baha sa Brgy. Tumana", with "Brgy. Tumana" as LOCATION | O, O, B-LOCATION, and I-LOCATION. Other tokens left out of the loss |  |  |
| UT-13 | Macro-F1 | True categories = A, A, B, B. Predicted = A, B, B, B | F1-score of A = 0.67. F1-score of B = 0.80. Macro-F1 = 0.73 |  |  |
| UT-14 | Span-level micro-F1 | Annotated = "Marikina" as LOCATION and "Bagyong Henry" as DISASTER_TYPE. Predicted = "Marikina" as LOCATION, "Henry" as DISASTER_TYPE, and "rescue team" as RESCUE | Precision = 0.33. Recall = 0.50. Micro-F1 = 0.40 |  |  |
| UT-15 | Cohen's kappa | Annotator 1 = A, A, A, A, A, B, B, B, B, B. Annotator 2 = A, A, A, A, B, A, B, B, B, B | Observed agreement = .80. Chance agreement = .50. Kappa = .60 |  |  |
| UT-16 | Relative change in F1-score | Candidate model = 0.76 and 0.66. Single-task models = 0.80 and 0.60 | −5.0% and +10.0%. Mean = +2.5% |  |  |
| UT-17 | Training cost of the two single-task models together | Training times = 1,200 s and 900 s. Peak memories = 5,000 MiB and 4,200 MiB | Training time = 2,100 s. Peak memory = 5,000 MiB |  |  |
| UT-18 | Overhead over equal weighting | Candidate model = 2,400 s. Equal weighting = 2,000 s | 20% |  |  |
| UT-19 | Training time is recorded | A run with one training step that waits 2 s | At least 2 s, and no longer than the whole run |  |  |
| UT-20 | Peak memory is recorded | A run that places one 100 MiB block on the GPU | At least 100 MiB |  |  |
| UT-21 | Paired t-test and its confidence interval | Final model = 0.81, 0.82, 0.83, 0.82, 0.82. Single-task model = 0.80 in all five runs | Mean difference = 0.02. *t*(4) = 6.32. *p* = .003. 95% confidence interval = 0.011 to 0.029 |  |  |
| UT-22 | Runs are paired by random seed | Final model runs listed by seed = 3, 1, 5, 2, 4. Single-task runs listed by seed = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 | Each run paired with the run of the same seed |  |  |

: Tests of the Scores, Training Cost, and Statistical Tests {#tbl-unit-tests-scores tbl-colwidths="[8,24,28,23,9,8]"}

| Test ID | What Is Checked | Input | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:------|:--------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|:--------|:-----|
| UT-23 | Equal weighting | Task losses = 2.0 and 1.0 | Combined loss = 3.0 |  |  |
| UT-24 | Linear scalarization | Task losses = 2.0 and 1.0. Task weights = 0.3 and 0.7 | Combined loss = 1.3 |  |  |
| UT-25 | MGDA, gradients of equal size without conflict | Task gradients = (1, 0) and (0, 1) | Task weights = 0.5 and 0.5. Update = (0.5, 0.5) |  |  |
| UT-26 | PCGrad, gradients without conflict | Task gradients = (1, 0) and (0, 1) | Gradients unchanged |  |  |
| UT-27 | PCGrad, gradients in conflict | Task gradients = (1, 0) and (−1, 1) | After projection = (0.5, 0.5) and (0, 1). Update = (0.5, 1.5) |  |  |
| UT-28 | Nash-MTL, gradients of different sizes | Task gradients = (2, 0) and (0, 1) | Weight of the first task about half that of the second |  |  |
| UT-29 | GradNorm trains the encoder in the first epoch | The first epoch on a small two-task model | Encoder weights changed |  |  |
| UT-30 | Every optimizer completes a training step | One step on a small two-task model with each of the 13 optimizers | Shared weights changed. No error |  |  |
| UT-31 | A random seed fixes the order of the training posts | Models 1 and 2 with seed 1. Model 3 with seed 2 | Same order for Models 1 and 2. Different order for Model 3 |  |  |
